evidences.summary: DIRTY_IGNORE_PREFIXES contained 'aria-tools/'; both build_repo_snapshot and tool_runner._workspace_snapshot_raw routed through ignored_dirty_path and silently dropped every aria-tools/ write — defeating Plan 022 §C-5 raw-vs-scoped partition before it could classify.

`if isinstance(ref, dict) and isinstance(ref.get('path'), str) and declared_read_paths:` — empty list is falsy; read_paths=[] skipped subset enforcement entirely. A tool emitting findings with read_paths=[] passed evidence validation.
register_tool else branch appended a brand-new tool with no status validation. First-time register_tool({status: 'ACTIVE'}) landed ACTIVE without going through transition_tool.

_OPERATOR_APPROVAL_GATED_FIELDS = ('runner', 'allowed_read_globs', 'forbidden_read_globs', 'declared_scope') — health_thresholds NOT in set. update_tool rewrote precision_min / critical_false_positives without operator approval.
_read_diff_from_action ran git diff <base>..<branch> in workspace_root cwd. Worktree drift (uncommitted as any / // @ts-ignore) invisible; multi-worktree branches diff against wrong tree.

_gh_pr_snapshot derived required_checks from gh pr checks stdout (already-run checks), not gh api branch protection (required-by-protection). PR with 0 runs + protection requiring ci-affected → required=[], auto-merge eligible.
Argv builder did not always pass --head <branch>; rev-parse failure logged but resolved_head_sha=None silently kept on proposal payload.
latest_head_sha = _first_string(github, 'latest_head_sha') or head_sha — lookup failure masquerades as match. Force-push between PR open and auto-merge invisible.
heartbeat_claim + submit_claim_result checked terminal events only; no lease_expires_at > utc_now() time-check. Past-expiry leases (no reaper sweep yet) accepted heartbeat AND submit.
validate_response checked envelope.request_id == request.request_id but did NOT compare envelope.claim_id / envelope.agent_id to the leased identity. Stitched envelopes from different leases passed.
_fixture_result_has_real_execution_provenance shape-only check — execution_run_id existence, no fixture-runs ledger lookup. Caller fabricated execution_run_id passed.
resolve_fixture_dir + resolve_case_workspace did NOT enforce relative_to(repo_root). Path escape via fixture_set='../../etc/passwd' resolved outside repo.
review_executor_diff source_agent == reviewer used exact-string compare. Case / NBSP / unicode-confusable variants bypassed self-review block.
run_enterprise_cycle ran tool loop first; _run_extended_phases at :152 ran AFTER tools complete. Architecture-baseline / validation-matrix pre-checks observed consequences, could not gate dispatch.
validation_matrix and pr_lifecycle phases emitted governance events and returned without invoking the real gate functions. Observability-only stubs.

_check_run_pass_layer accepted validation_run_ref if row passed=True and test path matched; the cmd that ran was not compared to the required test's expected command. echo ok satisfied nx test farm-service.

Missing fitness row default short-circuited stale=False with no tier cap; Plan 022 §H-6 max_triage_tier enforcement applied only when fitness row existed. Anonymous agents got auto_fix_safe via path-class only.

record_raw_findings_for_run flagged status='evidence_error' / 'scope_violation' as invalid_evidence; scope_out_mutation findings not flagged. Sampler reads runs.jsonl raw_findings_count without filtering by evidence_kind, so scope-out class re-enters the operator queue.

_confirmed_false_positive_fingerprints filter checked verdict == 'false_positive' only; source_type captured but never filtered. One ai_judge verdict (no human, no consensus) suppressed identical findings forever.
Evidence-ref path constructed as workspace_root / file_part with no .resolve().relative_to(workspace_root) guard. ../../etc/passwd in evidence_refs accepted by compliance gate.
passed = all(case['passed'] for case in case_results) — Python all([]) is True. Empty fixture suite promoted as 'pass'. agent_genesis.py:117 enforced len >= 3 results, not case_count > 0 per result.
Real-mode (mock_mode=False) accepted caller-provided real_response_envelope dict with no lease, no invocation_id, no transcript ledger. File-fed eval indistinguishable from real agent execution.
diff_text=None rejected; diff_text='' silently accepted. suppression_scanner.scan_unified_diff_text('') returns [] → 'clean' classification. Empty/malformed diff = clean.
Scanner only inspected lines starting with '+' (excluding '+++'); rename to / copy to / +++ b/<path> metadata never scanned. A rename to a file with banned tokens in path metadata bypassed the gate.
script_arg = next((a for a in argv if a.endswith(('.ts','.py','.js')))) — argv ['node', './node_modules/ts-node/dist/bin.js', 'adapter.ts'] picks 'bin.js' (the wrapper), real adapter never validated.
Allowlist membership check on tool_id only; entry shape (justification non-empty, plan_021_stream_a_owner non-empty) never enforced. Empty-justification entries accepted.
Review row lookup accepted EITHER packet_id OR ledger_hash. Alias accommodation lets future drift mask review-blocker misses.
_request_states grouped REQUEUED into 'claimed' list. REQUEUED is eligible-for-reclaim, not currently-claimed. Terminology drift confuses scheduler-vs-handoff-display layer.

tools/aria-adapters/typeorm-entity-schema-adapter.tool.json manifest exists but registry has no row for that tool_id — live validate_registry_adapter_sync against HEAD emits 1 missing_registry_row failure.
Plan 022 §M-3 invariant aria-plan-doc-presence will fail for plan 022 if Plan 022's doc is not committed under docs/aria/plans/. Operator-local /root/.claude/plans/ file is the only spec source.
